docs.summary: Draws Paper's canvas through Graphite. Each frame's geometry and draw calls are copied when Paper hands them over, and drawn by a host pass after the frame's views, into [`Target`](#api~Prowl.Motion.Target) or the window, so the UI can show what the views drew. Backdrop blur captures what is under a frosted shape and blurs it with dual Kawase.
Where the UI draws, null for the window.
